name: @openav/output
description: The stage on a projector or a second screen: an output window (a mirror of the stage's canvas, or the same page again following its clock), four-corner correction as a CSS homography, flip, rotation, border and soft edge, crops for several projectors from one canvas, blackout and brightness as params, the layout saved per output and as a file (open-audiovisual/output@1), and a clean address (?output) for a kiosk browser, OBS or TouchDesigner. No dependencies.

lab.autowire: Only exposes the kit, wires nothing: lab.output.openOutput(canvas, { name }) mirrors a work's canvas into a projector window (from a click) with corner-pin, a test pattern, fullscreen and the layout saved per name; cornerPin, cropBox and the layout file as pure functions. Mode 'page' and createOutputs need a createShow() page and stay out of the lab.
